perspective:
From Jose Castillo’s perspective:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual at work, especially since she is normally more vibrant.
- When he asked if she was okay, she said it was “nothing really” and just “some personal stuff,” but thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated that.

- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned he had been reading up on financial planning strategies and offered to talk about them.
- Patricia said she had been feeling overwhelmed with bills and might take him up on his offer.

- After that conversation, he worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances.
- He told Patricia he was trying to help, not pry, and she assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said it was good to have someone to turn to.

- In a later check-in, Patricia said she was doing fine and planned to have a quiet weekend at home. She asked about his weekend plans.
- He mentioned he would probably read and relax, and reminded her he was available if she needed anything.
- She thanked him and said she would keep that in mind.

- He has continued checking in with her regularly at work, offering support even in small ways like grabbing a coffee.
- Patricia told him she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that they’re all there to help each other out.
